title: Security appliance firmware versions MX 19.1.3 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta appliance firmware is now available on Thu, 30 May 2024

What's new: Stability enhancements and framework for future features
Supported products notice: VMX-XL appliances are not yet supported in the MX 19.1 beta. VMX-XL appliances that are configured for this version will not upgrade.
Legacy products notice: When configured for this version, Z1 devices will run MX 14.56.
When configured for this version, MX400 and MX600 devices will run MX 16.16.9.
When configured for this version, MX64(W), MX65(W), MX84, MX100, and vMX100 devices will run MX 18.107.10.
Known issues: There is an increased risk of encountering device stability and performance issues on all platforms and across all configurations.

Security appliance firmware versions MX 19.1.3 changelog

What's new

  • Stability enhancements and framework for future features

Supported products notice

  • VMX-XL appliances are not yet supported in the MX 19.1 beta. VMX-XL appliances that are configured for this version will not upgrade.

Legacy products notice

  • When configured for this version, Z1 devices will run MX 14.56.
  • When configured for this version, MX400 and MX600 devices will run MX 16.16.9.
  • When configured for this version, MX64(W), MX65(W), MX84, MX100, and vMX100 devices will run MX 18.107.10.

Known issues

  • There is an increased risk of encountering device stability and performance issues on all platforms and across all configurations.
